title: £27M Thelwall Viaduct Upgrade Underway
summary: Work has begun on a £27 million vital upgrade and joint replacement project for the Thelwall Viaduct in Cheshire.

title: Cat-Clawed Drone Lands on Ice Walls
summary: Researchers at the Université de Sherbrooke developed the Ice Dart quadcopter to land securely on near-vertical ice walls.

title: U.S. Navy Funds Embedded-Power UAV Composites
summary: The U.S. Navy funded Phase II for embedded-power UAV composites, encompassing 30 months of R&D.

title: CollPlant Acquires LightSolver
summary: CollPlant is acquiring LightSolver in a photonic computing deal focused on laser-based optimization workloads.

title: Lewes to Haywards Heath Railway Line Reopened
summary: Network Rail completed derailment cleanup and track renewal, allowing services between Lewes and Haywards Heath to resume.

title: SiMa.ai and ARK Electronics Partner on Drones
summary: The companies partnered to offer Modalix MLSoC bundles for autonomous commercial, industrial, and defense drone applications.

title: Anyon and KMT Partner for Quantum Deployment
summary: KMT will provide installation and support as Anyon develops 72-qubit and larger superconducting quantum computing systems.

title: Advancing CFET Device Roadmap with Novel Integration Modules
summary: Pioneering work develops critical CFET modules including an improved backside contact module and a novel gate stack for threshold voltage tuning.

title: US Army Approves 20 Nuclear Micro-Reactors
summary: The US Army authorized the construction of up to 20 nuclear micro-reactors on domestic military bases.

title: Karst Collapse Risk Assessment for Urban Metro Engineering
summary: Researchers propose an integrated framework combining geological characterization and hydrodynamic simulation to assess karst collapse risks in urban metro engineering.

title: Porous Liquid Crystal Elastomers for Tunable Acoustic Properties
summary: Researchers developed a porous liquid crystal elastomer platform enabling wide-range, reversible acoustic tuning via thermal-driven pore reconfiguration.

title: Long-Range Modulation of Pt Sites in MOFs Enhances H2O2 Activation
summary: Engineers designed Pt@UiO-66-X nanozymes to demonstrate how ligand electronegativity controls catalytic performance for pesticide detection.

title: Back-Analysis Method for Shear Strength Parameters of Double-Layered Slopes
summary: A new upper-bound back-analysis method improves shear strength parameter determination for double-layered slopes and controls inversion dispersion.

title: Passive Suppression of Gradual Opening in Wave Rotor Combustors
summary: An unpartitioned inlet duct design improves fuel-air mixing and suppresses interface distortion in wave rotor combustors.

title: Limit-State Capacity Sampling and Seismic Damage-State Distributions
summary: A unified probabilistic framework evaluates multi-limit-state capacity sampling models and their bias effects on seismic damage-state distributions.

title: Gate-Side Hydrogen Regulation via NiO Interlayer in ITO FETs
summary: An in-situ grown NiO interlayer regulates gate-side hydrogen in ITO FETs to suppress the PBTI-induced threshold-voltage shift.

title: Phosphorylated Chitin-Hydroxyapatite Composite Promotes Bone Repair
summary: A novel composite combining phosphorylated chitin and hydroxyapatite promotes angiogenesis, osteogenesis, and bone defect repair.

title: Portable Micro-Indentation Instrument for In-Service Structures
summary: A new portable micro-indentation instrument tests mechanical properties of in-service structures with high-resolution load and depth measurements.

title: Predicting Plug Development of Large-Diameter Steel Pipe Piles
summary: Researchers used the coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian method to examine and predict soil plug development for large-diameter steel pipe piles in clay.

title: Digital Image Correlation Improves Concrete Model Validation
summary: Researchers compared concrete constitutive models using digital image correlation and found that the strain-dependent Massicotte model aligns best with experimental crack patterns.

title: Optimizing Turnout Stiffness in High-Speed Railways
summary: A modified genetic algorithm optimizes high-speed railway turnout stiffness to reduce wheel-rail contact forces and improve structural durability.

title: Analyzing Stability Switching in BAM Neural Networks
summary: This article investigates stability switching and Hopf bifurcation in fractional-order bidirectional associative memory neural networks featuring higher-order interactions.

title: Geopolymer-Stabilized Pond Ash for Pavements
summary: Studies show that geopolymer additives improve the hydromechanical properties of pond ash, making it a sustainable and effective pavement base material.

title: Automating Numerical Analysis in Geotechnical Design
summary: An AI-assisted workflow integrating Python and finite element modeling automates geotechnical analyses to improve design efficiency and evaluate hundreds of scenarios.

title: Optimization of Labyrinth-Fingertip Composite Seal Structure
summary: A combined numerical and Taguchi approach optimized a labyrinth-finger seal, achieving significant leakage reduction and lower peak temperatures.

title: Magnetic Fusogenic Liposomes Enable Direct Nanoparticle Delivery
summary: Researchers developed magnetic fusogenic liposomes that use lipid membrane fusion to achieve direct cytosolic delivery of magnetic nanoparticles.

title: Skild AI Unveils S1 Robot Foundation Model
summary: Skild AI launched its S1 robot foundation model, enabling robots to learn new tasks from demonstration videos.

title: Siemens Launches Eigen Engineering Agent in Thailand
summary: Siemens launched an AI tool that connects with TIA Portal to support PLC coding, HMI visualization, and device configuration.

title: Massive Thermal Anomaly Discovered Beneath Martian Surface
summary: Researchers discovered a large thermal anomaly under the surface of Mars, highlighting the planet's two distinct halves.

title: Advanced Cooling Technologies Tackle Automotive Heat Challenge
summary: New cooling solutions are being developed to manage rising heat fluxes driven by electric drivetrains, AI processors, and autonomous systems.
